chunks: From him, from al-Qāsim ibn Muḥammad al-Jawharī, from al-Ḥusayn ibn Abī al-ʿAlāʾ, who said:
I asked Abā ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام about a man placing his hands before his knees in the salat (prayer). He said: Yes.

key_terms.أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ: Abā ʿAbdillāh, Imam Jaʿfar al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام
key_terms.سَأَلْتُ: I asked; indicates a direct legal inquiry to the Imam عليه السلام

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to place the hands before the knees when going down in salat (prayer)?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about the manner of descending for sajdah in salat (prayer). Imam Abā ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام affirms the permissibility of placing the hands before the knees.
